messages:
noah (People Ops): Heads-up: planning a small 'Thank You' desk-drop for next Thurs. Thinking 40 recognition envelopes (mix of $20 coffee e-codes + card + sticker). Need pickup, packing, and sign-off.

maya (People Ops): good idea. keep total <$50 per person to avoid tax reporting.

kevin (Finance): confirm budget cap; i can approve up to $750 on short-form. send estimate + vendor invoice.

ellis (HR): confirm policy: avoid promissory language and don't promise future bonuses. Card copy ok if neutral.

zack (Facilities): vendor can deliver between 9-10am; we can use loading bay. I'll reserve a table near reception for distribution.

noah (People Ops): action items: maya to gather recipient emails, kevin to route payment, ellis to approve copy, zack to confirm table. Packing run at 11:45am day-of. Volunteers?

maya (People Ops): i'll grab 3 volunteers. will add recipients to sheet and link invoice.

reminder-bot: Reminder set: "Recognition desk-drop pickup" on 2026-05-12 09:15 (organizer: noah).

noah (People Ops): thanks all — i'll post final vendor link and the approved card copy tomorrow.
